package.name: aav_lane_finder
package.description: The lane finder's launch file (lane_finder.launch.py), its config (lane_finder.yaml) and its maths in Python with no ROS (birds_eye.py, lane_lines.py: a bird's-eye warp of a flat road, a mask for the paint, sliding windows, a second-order fit per line; classic OpenCV). The node that publishes /perception/lane/geometry is aav_lane_finder_rs's (or the learned challenger's); the Python node was removed on 22 Nov 2026.
